usa.notes: Primary Saturn reconstruction baseline. Media/firmware identity from Codex #462/PR #467; pinned core and repeatable bridge from #27/PR #468. Complete lock JSON is private (content-addressed under /home/dev/neptune-research-private/462/disposable-usa-media/locks/); its digest is not republished here, so disc_lock_sha256 stays null.

japan.notes: Secondary comparative Saturn profile. Kept strictly separate from USA, PAL, Power Bomberman, and Neptune 12-seat extensions. #468 ran only a 300-frame Japan smoke test, not three-process replay.

domains.title: Pinned USA/Japan releases, BIOS, filesystem and byte-range accounting

usa.denominator_basis: ISO-9660 files on Track 01 (5 directories). observed = located, hashed and sector-accounted with EDC verified; decoded = container structure validated by magic/structure; validated = byte-identical to an independently held artefact (#463 asset repo).

japan.denominator_basis: ISO-9660 files on Track 01 (root directory only); same counter definitions as USA.

known_leads_from_463: 3 complete Sega FILM 1.04 CPK streams (BOMSS1.CPK, BOMSS2.CPK, BOMSS3.CPK; 320x160 cvid, 22050 Hz stereo) plus 1 truncated 2 MiB .goutputstream-4XSJ30 prefix of BOMSS2.CPK.
19 AIFF audio files (M_007.AIF..M_067.AIF, 44100 Hz) requiring byte/sector comparison against disc tracks/files.
open_unknowns: Internal section layout and compression of every PROGRAM.BIN bank (236 USA / 240 Japan); entropy ~7.03 bits/byte suggests compressed payloads (hypothesis).
Loader code path in the boot executable that maps bank names to Low-WRAM loads at runtime.
Format of the 56 USA unclassified binaries (NetLink/XBAND support files); low priority for game rules.
Whether a PAL (MK-81070-50) disc is available; the asset repo CPK files are PAL-rate and have no NTSC match.

usa.unknown_files_note: 56 unclassified binaries: 38 NETLINK/*.BMP (no BM magic), 8 NETLINK/*.WDT, NETLINK/DATASECT.BIN, PARENTAL.HTM, XS028000.EXE, 5 XBAND/*, FLD_KNL.BIN, XBMAP.BIN. Extensions are not trusted.

measured_inventory.regional_cdda: Tracks 03..30 align at a -588 stereo-sample (one CD-DA sector) Japan offset; 6 tracks (19, 22, 24, 25, 26, 30) are bit-exact over the full overlap and the rest differ in 17,766 of 433,666,464 overlapping bytes in total (99.9959% identical). Track 02 differs in length and was not aligned.
measured_inventory.pal_cpk_finding: Asset-repo BOMSS2.CPK has 2,845 STAB video frames vs 3,414 on both NTSC discs (ratio 5/6 = 25/30 fps). Hypothesis: asset-repo CPK files are PAL rips; they must not be used for NTSC profiles.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Track 01 of each #462-locked Saturn Bomberman CUE contains a valid Sega Saturn IP.BIN system header and ISO-9660 file hierarchy accounting for boot SH-2 code, BOMSS*.CPK Cinepak streams, sound driver/banks, and packed graphics/map containers, while remaining tracks are Red Book CD-DA.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Verified #462 USA and Japan input-lock manifests on read-only staged media (zero modification of /home/dev/Sega-Saturn-BIOS).
next_experiments.changed_variable: Compare USA vs Japan disc header, ISO-9660 directory entries, sector ranges, and SHA-256 digests against #463 BOMSS1..3.CPK and M_*.AIF leads.
expected_observations: 100% byte/sector range accounting of Track 01 and all CUE-referenced BIN tracks for USA and Japan.
Exact regional product serials, revision strings, and binary file/archive inventory with unknown compression formats isolated for decoder work.
failure_conditions: Any sector or byte range on Track 01 is silently skipped instead of classified.
File extensions are reported as decoded formats without magic/structure validation.
next_experiments.result_summary: Both discs: 100% Track 01 block accounting with 0 EDC mismatches; 430 USA / 25 Japan ISO-9660 files; PROGRAM.BIN bank container decoded at header level (236/240 banks, 52 byte-identical across regions); 20 USA and 9 Japan files byte-identical to the #463 asset repo; asset-repo CPKs match neither disc.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Each PROGRAM.BIN bank's 11 header pointers delimit sections whose payloads use one or more Hudson compression schemes; a decoder validated by byte-exact comparison with the bank image the game itself places in Low-WRAM will recover raw code, graphics, palettes, maps and SCSP data.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Pinned USA disc (static) plus a #27 checkpoint at a known screen, read through a separate forked core build with read-only memory export (coordinated heavy slot).
next_experiments.changed_variable: Static decoder output for a named bank vs the Low-WRAM region read from the emulator after the game loads that bank.
expected_observations: Section boundaries from header pointers match runtime-resident data ranges.
Decoder output is byte-identical to resident Low-WRAM for at least base1 and one world bank.
Byte-identical USA/Japan banks (normal2..4, s_init) decode to identical outputs.
failure_conditions: Any decoded section differs from the runtime-resident bytes.
Section types are asserted from bank names without structural or runtime evidence.
Raw ROM, RAM or state bytes are committed or sent to a model provider.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Bounded VDP1 command/texture/CLUT and VDP2 tile/palette capture on pinned Beetle Saturn recovers raw indexed sprites, palettes, anchors, and frame durations for White Bomberman, Normal Stage 1-1, and Standard Battle Arena without altering canonical replay hashes.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Pinned #27 USA checkpoint in fresh isolated process with fixed RTC, clean backup RAM, and deterministic input script.
next_experiments.changed_variable: Enable vs disable bounded VDP1/VDP2 read-only instrumentation across identical 3-process replays.
expected_observations: Identical canonical gameplay/video digests with and without VDP tracing enabled.
Recovered raw indexed textures, palettes, draw coordinates, and frame durations filling the three #463 gap tables.
failure_conditions: Instrumentation alters emulated timing or replay digests.
Reconstructed sample frame diverges from reference frame beyond documented renderer rules.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Controlled single-variable input sweeps from #27 checkpoints measure exact subpixel speed, corner assistance, and bomb fuse/chain frame counts, allowing compare_trace.py to pass on matching Neptune Saturn-profile scenarios and fail on a 1-frame fuse or subpixel mutation.
next_experiments.controlled_initial_state: Pinned #27 battle arena checkpoint and equivalent Neptune scenario adapter.
next_experiments.changed_variable: 1-frame directional press/release, bomb placement, chain-reaction distance, and deliberate +/-1 tick fuse mutation.
expected_observations: Exact frame-by-frame trace agreement on canonical fixed-point observations and deterministic failure on deliberate mutation.
failure_conditions: Trace comparator passes on synthetic or mutated traces or masks unstable fields.
